capture: runtime/catalog.json (base comparison recording; domain locators use original refIds)
inventory: Device identities are the union of device info, resource and radio query labels. No captured device names or fixed fleet totals are embedded in the application. Independent query labels retain a device row when one source disappears. Complete absence cannot establish offline state or inventory completeness.
wanFreshness: The 180-second metric-age guard matches H_WNG/H_WNH and the accepted Home WAN logic. It is collection freshness, not a new health or latency threshold.
registration: I_net_tmobileRegistered includes or vector(0). The live expression is unchanged to match the recording. Only 1 supplies positive registration evidence; 0, absence, ambiguity and failed collection stay unknown.
portAttribution: I_net_wanPorts retains WAN group only, while R_net_wanRx/R_net_wanTx retain port only. No captured evidence establishes an eth8/eth9-to-provider join. Rates sum by port across gateways, losing device identity as well.
uncaptured: Collector up, per-device CPU/memory histories, device-labelled WAN rates, switch port RX/TX, radio utilization histories and VAP traffic are live-only optional queries. Recorded mode must not synthesize those samples from instant values or aggregate port rates.
liveAdaptation: The preview rate expressions adapted in queries.json use job=unifi-api and a fixed 6-minute window to match captured gateway rates. The native stock dashboards retain their original selectors and $__interval windows. The detail renderer filters name/wan/port labels; preview queries preserve port_id, port_num, port_name and radio labels. Raw radio utilization uses the same metric family as the captured instant radioBusy query. No production queries were issued.
